summary.zh: Goodsell 风格的分子与细胞插图。渲染只在浏览器里；这里给 Agent 的是它整理的指针数据（哪些大模型可看、"月度分子"对应哪些 PDB 结构、各种生物膜的脂质组成）和几个对公开数据库的查询。查询结果来自外部数据库，随它们更新而变。
summary.en: Goodsell-style illustrations of molecules and cells. Rendering happens in the browser only; what agents get here is its curated pointer data (which large models can be viewed, which PDB structures each Molecule of the Month covers, the lipid make-up of biological membranes) and a few lookups against public databases. Lookup results come from external databases and change as they do.

description.zh: 19 个整装的大模型（病毒颗粒、细胞片段等）：标题、关键词、来源、说明。
description.en: 19 assembled large models (virions, cell fragments and more): title, keywords, source and caption.

datasets.licence: MIT (this index; each model keeps the licence stated in its record)

provenance.zh: 每条的 source 写明模型从哪里取，许可在记录里逐条写明。
provenance.en: Each record's `source` says where the model is fetched from, and its licence is stated per record.

description.zh: RCSB PDB"月度分子"专栏的 322 期：期号、标题、涉及的 PDB 编号。
description.en: The 322 instalments of RCSB PDB's Molecule of the Month: number, title and the PDB ids covered.

datasets.licence: MIT (this index of titles and ids; the articles themselves belong to RCSB PDB)

provenance.zh: 由仓库里的脚本从 RCSB PDB 的专栏页面整理；只有标题和编号，没有正文。
provenance.en: Compiled from RCSB PDB's column pages by a script in the repository; titles and ids only, no article text.

description.zh: 八种膜内外两叶的脂质比例、胆固醇含量和依据。
description.en: Lipid proportions of both leaflets, cholesterol content and the basis, for eight membranes.

provenance.zh: basis 字段写明每种膜的数字依据的文献；是整理后的近似值。
provenance.en: The `basis` field cites the literature behind each membrane's numbers; they are curated approximations.

description.zh: 按化学成分编号取一个配体的理想三维坐标（SDF 文本，来自 RCSB）。
description.en: Fetch the ideal 3D coordinates of a ligand by its chemical component id (SDF text, from RCSB).

id.description: 化学成分编号，例如 ATP / a chemical component id, e.g. ATP

output.zh: 一段 SDF 格式的文本。

description.zh: 一个膜蛋白结构在脂双层里的朝向和厚度（来自 OPM / PDBTM）。
description.en: Orientation and thickness of a membrane protein structure in the bilayer (from OPM / PDBTM).

pdb.description: 四位 PDB 编号 / a four-character PDB id

output.zh: orientation 对象：膜的半厚度、跨膜的残基等，带来源。
output.en: An `orientation` object: the membrane half-thickness, the membrane-spanning residues and more, with its source.

title.en: Summary and citation of a structure

description.zh: 一个 PDB 结构的标题、方法、分辨率、原子数和原始文献（来自 RCSB）。
description.en: Title, method, resolution, atom count and primary publication of a PDB structure (from RCSB).

pdb.description: 四位 PDB 编号 / a four-character PDB id

output.zh: entry 对象：标题、发布日期、方法、分辨率、文献。
output.en: An `entry` object: title, release date, method, resolution and citation.

description.zh: 一个蛋白的 AlphaFold 预测结构的地址和置信度信息。
description.en: Where to fetch the AlphaFold prediction for a protein, with confidence information.

acc.description: UniProt 编号 / a UniProt accession

output.zh: prediction 对象：模型文件的地址、高置信残基的比例、来源。
output.en: A `prediction` object: the model file's URL, the share of confident residues and the source.

description.zh: 一个蛋白参与的预测复合物（AlphaFold DB）：名称、界面置信度、组成、模型地址。
description.en: Predicted complexes a protein takes part in (AlphaFold DB): name, interface confidence, composition and model URL.

acc.description: UniProt 编号 / a UniProt accession
